zh: 伦敦塔卫兵（穿传统制服）
en: a guard who dresses in a traditional uniform at the Tower of London
a thick slice of good quality beef
big or fat
ex: beefy men/arms/thighs
粗壮的人／胳膊／大腿

en: a structure made for bees to live in
a person who owns and takes care of bees
the activity of owning and taking care of bees
a name for the devil

zh: （非洲操异国口音的）学成归来者，海归人
en: a person who returns to his or her home in Africa after studying, working, etc. in a foreign country. People are often identified as been-tos because they have a different accent (= way of pronouncing the words of a language).

zh: （汽车喇叭或电子设备发出的）嘟嘟声，哔哔声
en: a short high sound such as that made by a car horn or by electronic equipment
ex: The taxi gave a beep as it drew up to the house.
出租车驶上房屋时发出哔哔声。

en: a small electronic device that you carry around with you and that lets you know when somebody is trying to contact you, by making a sound
an alcoholic drink made from malt with hops added to give it taste. There are many types of beer.
ex: a pint/can/bottle of beer
一品脱/罐/瓶啤酒

en: a man’s very fat stomach, caused by drinking a lot of beer over a long period
ex: He's only twenty but he already has a beer belly.
他才 20 岁，但已经有啤酒肚了。

en: a room for storing beer below a pub or bar

zh: 啤酒花园（酒馆的露天摊位）
en: an outdoor area at a pub or bar with tables and chairs
ex: The pub has a beer garden round the back.
这个酒馆后面附设一个啤酒园。

zh: 啤酒眼镜（wear beer goggles 表示饮酒过量后会觉得相貌平平者很有吸引力）
en: you say that somebody is wearing beer goggles when they have drunk too much alcohol and are attracted to somebody that they would not usually find attractive
a small piece of thick card that you put under a glass, usually in a bar, etc. in order to protect the surface below
